description: This file contains the Bootstrap modal component implementation (version 3.3.7), defining the Modal class with methods for showing, hiding, and managing modal dialogs, including event handling and transitions.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: Class representing Bootstrap modal dialog with methods for control and event handling.

methods.name: enforceFocus
methods.description: Ensure focus stays within the modal.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Handle escape key to close modal.

methods.name: backdrop
methods.description: Create or remove modal backdrop with transition effects.

methods.name: adjustDialog
methods.description: Adjust modal dialog styling for overflow.

methods.name: checkScrollbar
methods.description: Check if scrollbar is present and measure width.

methods.name: resetScrollbar
methods.description: Reset body padding after modal close.
